'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Thomas Whalen LS Plead My Case''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Thomas Whalen]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Thomas Whalen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
